name: Mumble Pines: The Arrival
detailed_description:
What you get:

  • A Nightmare Beneath the Surface – A remote island, a hidden underground research facility, and horrors that should have never been awakened. Experience an intense 3-4 hour horror journey.

  • Nowhere is Safe – Something is hunting you—multiple entities lurk in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

  • A Dark and Twisted Mystery – You came here searching for your brother, but what you’ll uncover goes far beyond a simple disappearance.

  • A World of Fear and Discovery – The island hides disturbing secrets. Dare to explore, and you may find things that will haunt you forever.

  • A Deeply Unsettling Atmosphere – Oppressive darkness, eerie silence, and spine-chilling jumpscares make this an unforgettable horror experience.

  • Explore the Island – Venture beyond the main path… but be warned, some discoveries are better left undisturbed.

  • You will never Leave again!


THE ISLAND AWAITS YOU.....

...two years ago, a remote summer camp was abruptly shut down after a string of unexplained incidents, strange disappearances, eerie rumors, and a growing sense of unease surrounded the island, but with no clear evidence, the authorities closed the case. Now, time has buried the truth ... until you set foot on the island.

Try to find him....

....when your younger brother vanishes without a trace, you refuse to accept the official explanation. With no help from the police, you take matters into your own hands and get a janitor job to examine the camp, where your brother was last seen. What begins as a desperate search soon turns into something far more unsettling...

On your mission to find answers, you explore the island. Maybe you find some clues on the way. As darkness falls, forbidden areas are easier to explore, but with only a dim flashlight to guide you, every shadow could be hiding something. Navigate through abandoned cabins, forgotten tunnels, and overgrown paths, piecing together clues that could lead to answers...

An atmospheric blend of mystery and psychological tension, this game challenges you to face what still lingers in the shadows. Will you uncover the truth, or will the island claim another lost soul...? 


                                                          YOU DECIDE....

short_description: In this first-person story-driven horror game, you take a job as a janitor to access a run-down island summer camp that got shut down, after the dissapearence of your younger brother, which was only one of many incidents. It’s up to you to uncover the island’s buried secrets.

content_descriptors.notes: Our game explores themes of past experiments conducted on teenagers, presented through environmental storytelling. While there are no explicit depictions of these events, players may encounter unsettling locations, disturbing audio logs, and visual clues that hint at the dark history of these experiments. The game aims to provoke thought rather than shock, focusing on atmosphere, mystery and graphic content.
